source_basis.citation: Ross PJ (2011), Numerical Solution of the Continuity Equation for Soil Water Flow Using Precomputed Steady-State Fluxes, Vadose Zone Journal 10:760-766
source_basis.source_bound_fact: Ross obtains the two endpoint derivatives of each face flux together with the steady-flux table interpolation and uses them in the tridiagonal first-order time-step system.

prescribed_bottom_head_candidate.input: H_bottom supplied by the common groundwater boundary/coupler contract
prescribed_bottom_head_candidate.primary_output: realized conservative q_bottom from the same accepted trial

tangent_derivation_candidate: Build the normal Ross trial linear system A * Delta_v = b using the start-state face fluxes and table derivatives.
Differentiate the same discrete trial equations with respect to H_bottom while freezing the active table cells, saturation modes and timestep/limiter regime.
Solve A * s = r_H for s=d(Delta_v)/dH_bottom using the same tridiagonal coefficients/factorization when reusable.
Evaluate dq_bottom/dH_bottom from the explicit bottom-face boundary derivative plus the bottom-cell-state derivative times s_bottom.
Return the tangent only together with its active-regime diagnostics.

cost_target.normal_trial: one bounded O(Ncells) tridiagonal solve per internal step after O(1) face-table lookups
cost_target.tangent_incremental_work: one additional O(Ncells) tridiagonal backsolve per accepted internal step when the same factorization is reusable

fail_closed_conditions: bottom response crosses a saturated/unsaturated state switch
table interpolation cell changes invalidate the local derivative assumption at the requested perturbation scale
timestep acceptability or limiter regime changes
ponding/deponding or other boundary regime switch
local dq_bottom/dH_bottom is zero, nonfinite or too ill-conditioned to invert safely

preferred_research_paths: use a directly formulated flux-boundary row in the same continuity solve when mathematically clean
or locally invert the qualified head-response only when dq_bottom/dH_bottom is finite, nonzero and one-to-one in the active regime
prescribed_bottom_flux_candidate.forbidden: blind reciprocal tangent or hidden boundary correction across a regime switch

transaction_semantics.rollback: discard candidate state and tangent together
transaction_semantics.warm_start: numerical factorization/scratch may be reused only for the same physically correct committed base state

qualification_gates: compare analytical/discrete tangent against symmetric +/-DeltaH trials from identical committed state
sweep bottom head through recharge, zero-flux and capillary-rise regimes
verify mass ledger is unchanged by tangent calculation
measure incremental tangent cost and worst-case internal substep count
verify tangent unavailable flag at regime discontinuities rather than returning misleading values
